entity: earthquake swarm around Red River Parish, Louisiana: none before 2024, then dozens topped by the March 2026 M4.9
why: Tulane, the state agency and The Advocate report the same finding: an unusual swarm in a previously quiet area, the record M4.9, injection wells under investigation, with their own M2.5+ counts. Our box counts (0 then 29) are the same measure re-sliced, not added value.
